scope: Bounded actual visual review of the two repaired v3 frames; unchanged corpus evidence carried from the v2 34-contact/340-frame review only after independent byte comparison.

equality_carryforward.comparison_method: Read and compare every named PNG byte sequence independently; count equal/different files, assert exact expected changed-frame set. Per-group equal-set digest hashes sorted frame + space + PNG sha256 lines with trailing newline.
equality_carryforward.excluded_from_image_equality_claim: Contact/audit composites were rebuilt with corrected captions and are not claimed byte-identical. Underlying frame images are the equality basis.
equality_carryforward.semantic_limit: Mechanical equality carries the earlier visual evidence and its limitations; it does not create a new semantic PASS.

repaired_frame_reviews.observation: The exposed upper arm and forearm now carry a continuous substantial skin selection and lighten in the tint. The prior unchanged orange arm is absent; adjacent cloak/front garment remains visually separate.
repaired_frame_reviews.claim_limit: This resolves the recorded substantial omission only; not full pixel accuracy or owner approval.

repaired_frame_reviews.observation: The image-left supporting arm now has a substantial skin selection and lightens along with the other arm. The adjacent carried log and cloak show no obvious new spill in the viewed panels.
repaired_frame_reviews.claim_limit: This resolves the recorded substantial omission only; not full pixel accuracy or owner approval.

retained_uncertainties.description: The rear/lower ponytail stays dark while the scalp becomes grey. Some ponytail interior is selected, but a dark lower patch remains unchanged. The same source ambiguity remains on the v2 enlarged panel.
retained_uncertainties.source_specific_uncertainty: The unselected patch is very dark and partly translucent at its edge. It may belong to intentionally protected ink/outline. The broad visual review cannot decide whether this is excessive hair omission or establish the formal 50 percent silhouette gate.
retained_uncertainties.carryforward_method: Source, skin, hair and all six tinted images are independently byte-identical to v2; semantic uncertainty is retained without reclassification. Not newly viewed in this bounded v3 review.

retained_uncertainties.description: Most of the small ponytail behind the raised arm remains dark while the main hair cap changes color. The same source ambiguity remains on the v2 enlarged panel.
retained_uncertainties.source_specific_uncertainty: The ponytail is small, dark, and partly overlaps the raised arm/axe area. Source colors alone do not establish whether the remaining dark pixels should be tintable hair or protected ink. No formal hair-coverage verdict is made.
retained_uncertainties.carryforward_method: Source, skin, hair and all six tinted images are independently byte-identical to v2; semantic uncertainty is retained without reclassification. Not newly viewed in this bounded v3 review.

retained_uncertainties.description: A thin selected vertical strip follows the image-right torso/garment seam below the arm. The same source ambiguity remains on the v2 enlarged panel.
retained_uncertainties.source_specific_uncertainty: The source is too ambiguous at this narrow seam to distinguish a small exposed-skin strip from hide trim confidently. Recorded for source-only review, not counted as confirmed clothing leakage.
retained_uncertainties.carryforward_method: Source, skin, hair and all six tinted images are independently byte-identical to v2; semantic uncertainty is retained without reclassification. Not newly viewed in this bounded v3 review.

retained_uncertainties.description: An isolated selected skin pixel at (28,59) sits on the image-left hair/log junction. Its source location is not cleanly separable as a visible ear versus wood in these panels.
retained_uncertainties.source_specific_uncertainty: Could be a small visible ear/skin pixel or log leakage. Source-only clarification was requested from the source annotator; no answer was available when this bounded review was recorded. It is not classified as a confirmed new spill.
retained_uncertainties.carryforward_method: Source, skin, hair and all six tinted images are independently byte-identical to v2; semantic uncertainty is retained without reclassification. Not newly viewed in this bounded v3 review.

Prior v1/v2 FAIL reports remain unchanged; this bounded repair review does not erase their findings.

No generated portraits or blind-review targets were inspected.
The new audit caption reads v4 stored transform; repaired displayed frames were actually viewed and hash-bound.
